title: Silver Zoom Card: Eligibility Requirements for Logistics Businesses
summary: This document covers Silver Zoom Card eligibility for logistics businesses, requiring personal credit at or above $680 and business credit at or above 57 on the PAYDEX scale. It also lists credit line underwriting ranges ($22,500–$175,000), interest on carried balances (20.99%), and an annual $74.50 membership fee, plus notes that meeting minimums doesn’t guarantee approval.
